entities.name: Astartes
entities.description: Superhuman, genetically modified warrior-monks who are foremost defenders of Humanity; many have betrayed the Imperium.

entities.name: Emperor of Mankind
entities.description: Ruler whose greatest warriors are the Astartes.

entities.name: Imperium of Man
entities.description: Human realm that many Astartes betrayed.

events.summary: Many Astartes betray the Imperium of Man and pledge themselves to ruinous powers.
events.quote: Many Astartes have betrayed the Imperium of Man , however, and pledged themselves to ruinous powers .

relations.quote: the greatest of the Emperor of Mankind's warriors.
